author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Lobbying contacts concentrate on a handful of departments and topics; Haight Economic Development Corporation paid lobbyists the most.
paragraphs: Contact lobbyists report every contact with a city officer, for which client and on what matter. The heat grid crosses clients with departments; the topic chart shows what the contacts were about. Lobbying is lawful and disclosed, which is exactly why it can be shown here.
Payments from clients to lobbyists are the amount side; contacts have no dollar value, so the amount filter does not appear on this view.

templates.template: {contacts_fmt} reported contacts by {lobbyists_fmt} lobbyist firms for {clients_fmt} clients, {years}; most-contacted target: {top_target} ({top_target_fmt} contacts); lobbyist payments {payments_total}.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.
